name: Set
sig: def Set (α : Type) : Type
body: α → Prop

name: mem
sig: def mem (s : Set α) (a : α) : Prop
body: s a
doc: `mem a s` says `a` belongs to `s`.

name: range
sig: def range (f : Nat → α) : Set α
body: fun a => ∃ n, f n = a

name: univ
sig: def univ : Set α
body: fun _ => True

name: mem_univ
sig: @[simp]theorem mem_univ (a : α) : a ∈ (univ : Set α)
body: trivial

name: ext
sig: theorem ext {s t : Set α} (h : ∀ a, a ∈ s ↔ a ∈ t) : s = t
body: funext fun a => propext (h a)

name: mem_inter_iff
sig: @[simp]theorem mem_inter_iff {s t : Set α} {a : α} : a ∈ s ∩ t ↔ a ∈ s ∧ a ∈ t
body: Iff.rfl

name: predR
sig: def predR {X : Type} (R : X → X → Prop) (x : X) : Set X
body: fun y => R y x
doc: `predR R x` is the set of `R`-predecessors of `x`, written `ρ[x]` in the sheet.

name: mem_predR
sig:
@[simp]theorem mem_predR {X : Type} {R : X → X → Prop} {x y : X} :
    y ∈ predR R x ↔ R y x
body: Iff.rfl

name: mem_sdiff_iff
sig: @[simp]theorem mem_sdiff_iff {s t : Set α} {a : α} : a ∈ s \ t ↔ a ∈ s ∧ ¬ a ∈ t
body: Iff.rfl

name: subset_antisymm
sig: theorem subset_antisymm {s t : Set α} (h1 : s ⊆ t) (h2 : t ⊆ s) : s = t
body: ext fun a => ⟨fun ha => h1 a ha, fun ha => h2 a ha⟩

name: nothing_empty
sig: @[simp]theorem nothing_empty {x : α} : ¬ x ∈ (∅ : Set α)
body: fun h => h

name: empty_subset
sig: @[simp]theorem empty_subset {s : Set α} : ∅ ⊆ s
body: fun _ h => h.elim

name: empty_inter
sig: @[simp]theorem empty_inter {s : Set α} : ∅ ∩ s = ∅
body: ext fun _ => ⟨fun ha => ha.1, fun ha => (nothing_empty ha).elim⟩

name: exists_mem_of_ne_empty
sig: @[simp]theorem exists_mem_of_ne_empty {s : Set α} : (s ≠ ∅) → ∃ x, x ∈ s
body: fun h => (Classical.byContradiction (fun nh => h (ext (fun a => ⟨fun hh => (nh (Exists.intro a hh)).elim, fun hh => (nothing_empty hh).elim⟩))))

name: sdiff_subset
sig: @[simp]theorem sdiff_subset {s r : Set α} : s \ r ⊆ s
body: fun _ h => h.1

name: PeanoLike
sig:
structure PeanoLike (A : Type) where
  z  : A
  S  : A → A
  h1 : Function.Injective S
  h2 : ∀ x, S x ≠ z
  h3 : ∀ x, x = z ∨ ∃ k, S k = x

variable {N : Type}(M : PeanoLike N)

open Set PeanoLike

name: l1
sig:
theorem l1 {X : Type} {P1 P2 Q : X → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P1 x ↔ P2 x) :
    (∀ x, (P1 x → Q x)) ↔ (∀ x, (P2 x → Q x))
body:
constructor
    · intro h1 x
      rw[← h x]
      exact h1 x
    · intro h1 x
      rw[h x]
      exact h1 x

name: Rel
sig: def Rel : N → N → Prop
body: fun k n => M.S k = n

name: prop11
sig: def prop11 : Prop
body: ∀ B : Set N, (M.z ∈ B ∧ ∀ n, (n ∈ B → M.S n ∈ B)) → B = univ

name: prop12
sig: def prop12 : Prop
body: ∀ B : Set N, (∀ n, (predR (Rel M) n ⊆ B → n ∈ B)) → B = univ

name: thm13
sig: theorem thm13 : prop11 M ↔ prop12 M
body:
apply l1
  intro B
  unfold predR Rel
  constructor
  · intro h n hh
    let h3 := M.h3
    specialize h3 n
    cases h3 with
    | inl hhh =>
      rw[hhh]
      exact h.1
    | inr hhh =>
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hhh
      rw[← hk]
      apply h.2 k
      apply hh
      exact hk
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply h
      intro k hk
      let h2 := M.h2
      specialize h2 k
      contradiction
    · intro n bn
      apply (h (M.S n))
      intro k hk
      let h1 := M.h1
      have hh : M.S k = M.S n := hk
      have : k = n := h1 hk
      rwa[this]

name: recursion_unique
sig:
theorem recursion_unique {A : Type} (hind : prop11 M) (a : A) (β : N × A → A)
    (γ δ : N → A)
    (hγ0 : γ M.z = a) (hγs : ∀ n, γ (M.S n) = β (n, γ n))
    (hδ0 : δ M.z = a) (hδs : ∀ n, δ (M.S n) = β (n, δ n)) :
    γ = δ
body:
funext n
  let B : Set N := fun k => γ k = δ k
  have hBu : B = univ := by
    apply hind B
    constructor
    · exact hγ0.trans hδ0.symm
    · intro k (hk : γ k = δ k)
      show γ (M.S k) = δ (M.S k)
      rw [hγs, hδs, hk]
  have hn : n ∈ B := by
    rw [hBu]
    exact mem_univ n
  exact hn
doc: Recursion theorem, uniqueness part.

name: RelSub
sig: def RelSub (σ ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x y, σ x y → ρ x y
doc: Notes: σ ⊆ ρ for binary relations.

name: relProd
sig: def relProd (ρ σ : X → X → Prop) : X → X → Prop
body: fun x z => ∃ y, ρ x y ∧ σ y z
doc: Notes: relative product ρ|σ.

name: RelRange
sig: def RelRange (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Set X
body: fun y => ∃ x, ρ x y
doc: Notes: Rρ, the range of ρ.

name: RelDomain
sig: def RelDomain (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Set X
body: fun x => ∃ y, ρ x y
doc: Notes: Dρ, the domain of ρ.

name: Field
sig: def Field (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Set X
body: fun x => x ∈ RelDomain ρ ∨ x ∈ RelRange ρ
doc: Notes: the field Fρ = Dρ ∪ Rρ.

name: IdOn
sig: def IdOn (A : Set X) : X → X → Prop
body: fun x y => (x = y) ∧ (A x)
doc: Notes: I_A.

name: relPow
sig:
def relPow (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Nat → X → X → Prop
  | 0 => IdOn (Field ρ)
  | n+1 => relProd (relPow ρ n) ρ
doc: Notes: ρ^n, with ρ^0 = I_{Fρ} and ρ^(n+1) = ρ^n | ρ.

name: relStar
sig: def relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : X → X → Prop
body: fun x y => ∃ n, relPow ρ n x y
doc: Notes: ρ* = ⋃ ρ^n over n ≥ 0.

name: relPlus
sig: def relPlus (ρ : X → X → Prop) : X → X → Prop
body: fun x y => ∃ n, relPow ρ (n+1) x y
doc: Notes: ρ⁺ = ⋃ ρ^n over n ≥ 1.

name: TransRel
sig: def TransRel (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x y z, ρ x y → ρ y z → ρ x z
doc: Notes: ρ is transitive.

name: IsFun
sig: def IsFun (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x y z, ρ x y → ρ x z → y = z
doc: Notes: ρ is a function (a single-valued relation).

name: trans_iff_relProd_sub
sig:
theorem trans_iff_relProd_sub (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    TransRel ρ ↔ RelSub (relProd ρ ρ) ρ
body:
constructor
  · intro h x z hxz
    obtain ⟨y, hx, hz⟩ := hxz
    exact h x y z hx hz
  · intro h x y z hxy hyz
    apply h
    exists y

name: isFun_relProd
sig:
theorem isFun_relProd {ρ σ : X → X → Prop}
    (hρ : IsFun ρ) (hσ : IsFun σ) : IsFun (relProd ρ σ)
body:
intro x y z hxy hxz
  obtain ⟨k,hx1, hy⟩ := hxy
  obtain ⟨l, hx2, hz⟩ := hxz
  have h : k = l := hρ x k l hx1 hx2
  apply hσ k y z
  · assumption
  · rw[h]; assumption

name: sigma_fun_on_range
body:
intro y hxy z w hyz hyw
  obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hxy
  apply h x z w
  · exists y
  · exists y

name: relProd_assoc_iff
sig:
theorem relProd_assoc_iff (ρ σ τ : X → X → Prop) (x w : X) :
    relProd (relProd ρ σ) τ x w ↔ relProd ρ (relProd σ τ) x w
body:
unfold relProd
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := hy1
    exists z
    constructor
    · assumption
    · exists y
  · intro ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := hy2
    exists z
    constructor
    · exists y
    · assumption

name: relProd_assoc
sig:
theorem relProd_assoc (ρ σ τ : X → X → Prop) :
    relProd (relProd ρ σ) τ = relProd ρ (relProd σ τ)
body:
ext x w
  exact relProd_assoc_iff ρ σ τ x w

name: relProd_not_comm
sig:
theorem relProd_not_comm :
    ¬ ∀ ρ σ : Nat → Nat → Prop, relProd ρ σ = relProd σ ρ
body:
simp
  let ρ : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun n m ↦ n = 0 ∧ m = 1
  let σ : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun n m ↦ n = 1 ∧ m = 2
  have h1 : relProd ρ σ 0 2 := ⟨1, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have h2 : ¬ relProd σ ρ 0 2 := by intro h; obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := h; have := (hk1.1); contradiction
  exists ρ, σ
  intro h
  apply h2
  rwa[← h]

name: relProd_idOn_field
sig:
theorem relProd_idOn_field {ρ : X → X → Prop} (m : Nat) :
    relProd (relPow ρ m) (IdOn (Field ρ)) = relPow ρ m
body:
ext x y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hz2
    rwa[← hy1]
  · intro h
    exists y
    constructor
    · assumption
    · constructor
      · rfl
      · cases m
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
          rwa[← h1]
        · rename_i n
          obtain ⟨k, h1, h2⟩ := h
          right
          exists k

name: relPow_add
sig:
theorem relPow_add (ρ : X → X → Prop) (m n : Nat) :
    relPow ρ (m + n) = relProd (relPow ρ m) (relPow ρ n)
body:
induction n with
  | zero => exact (relProd_idOn_field m).symm
  | succ n hn =>
    ext x y
    constructor
    · intro ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩
      have : m.add n = m + n := rfl
      rw[this, hn] at hz1
      obtain ⟨w, hw1, hw2⟩ := hz1
      exists w
      constructor
      · assumption
      · exists z
    · intro ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw1, hw2⟩ := hz2
      exists w
      constructor
      · have : m.add n = m + n := rfl
        rw[this, hn]
        exists z
      · assumption

name: relSub_relPlus
sig: theorem relSub_relPlus (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelSub ρ (relPlus ρ)
body:
intro x y hxy
  exists 0, x
  exact ⟨⟨rfl,Or.inl ⟨y, hxy⟩⟩, hxy⟩

name: relPlus_trans
sig: theorem relPlus_trans (ρ : X → X → Prop) : TransRel (relPlus ρ)
body:
intro x y z ⟨n, hxy⟩ ⟨m, hyz⟩
  exists (n + m + 1)
  have : n + m + 1 + 1 = (n + 1) + (m + 1):= by omega
  rw[this]
  rw[relPow_add ρ (n + 1) (m + 1)]
  exists y

name: relSub_relPow_succ
body:
induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x y ⟨z, ⟨h, hx1⟩, hz2⟩
    rw[← h] at hz2
    exact hρσ x y hz2
  | succ n hn =>
    intro x y ⟨z, hx1, hz2⟩
    have hxz := hn x z hx1
    have hzy := hρσ z y hz2
    exact hσ x z y hxz hzy

name: relPlus_least
sig:
theorem relPlus_least {ρ σ : X → X → Prop}
    (hρσ : RelSub ρ σ) (hσ : TransRel σ) : RelSub (relPlus ρ) σ
body:
intro x y ⟨n, hxy⟩
  exact relSub_relPow_succ hρσ hσ n x y hxy

name: ReflOn
sig: def ReflOn (A : Set X) (σ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x, (x ∈ A) → σ x x
doc: Notes: σ is reflexive on A.

name: reflOn_relStar
sig: theorem reflOn_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : ReflOn (Field ρ) (relStar ρ)
body:
intro _ _
  exists 0

name: relSub_relStar
sig: theorem relSub_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelSub ρ (relStar ρ)
body:
intro x y hxy
  exists 1, x
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rfl
    · left
      exists y
  · assumption

name: relStar_trans
sig: theorem relStar_trans (ρ : X → X → Prop) : TransRel (relStar ρ)
body:
intro x y z ⟨n, hxy⟩ ⟨m, hyz⟩
  exists (n + m)
  rw[relPow_add ρ n m]
  exists y

name: relStar_least
body:
intro x y ⟨n, hxy⟩
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨h, hx⟩ := hxy
    rw[h]
    apply hrefl
    rwa[← h]
  | succ k =>
    have := relSub_relPow_succ hρσ hσ k x y hxy
    assumption

name: relPlus_decomp
sig:
theorem relPlus_decomp {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x y : X} (h : relPlus ρ x y) :
    ∃ u, relStar ρ x u ∧ ρ u y
body:
obtain ⟨n, w, hn⟩ := h
  exists w
  constructor
  · exists n; exact hn.1
  · exact hn.2
doc: Notes, Remark 3: x ρ⁺ y gives u with x ρ* u and u ρ y.

name: relPlus_of_relPlus_relStar
sig:
theorem relPlus_of_relPlus_relStar {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x y z : X}
    (h1 : relPlus ρ x y) (h2 : relStar ρ y z) : relPlus ρ x z
body:
obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h2
  have h := relPow_add ρ (n + 1) m
  exists (n + m)
  have : n + m + 1 = n + 1 + m := by omega
  rw[this, h]
  exists y

name: relStar_relProd
sig:
theorem relStar_relProd (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    relProd (relStar ρ) ρ = relPlus ρ
body:
ext x y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨z, ⟨k, _⟩, _⟩
    exists k, z
  · intro ⟨k, ⟨z, _, _⟩⟩
    exists z
    constructor
    · exists k
    · assumption

name: relPow_one
sig: theorem relPow_one (ρ : X → X → Prop) : relPow ρ 1 = ρ
body:
ext x y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨z, ⟨h, _⟩, _⟩
    rwa[h]
  · intro h
    exists x
    constructor
    · constructor
      · rfl
      · left; exists y
    · assumption

name: relProd_relStar
sig:
theorem relProd_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    relProd ρ (relStar ρ) = relPlus ρ
body:
ext x y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨z, hz1, k, hk⟩
    have : relPow ρ (k + 1) x y := by
      rw[Nat.add_comm, relPow_add ρ 1 k]
      exists z
      constructor
      · rwa[relPow_one ρ]
      · assumption
    exists k
  · intro ⟨k, z, hkxz, hzy⟩
    have : relPow ρ (k + 1) x y := by
      exists z
    rw[Nat.add_comm, relPow_add ρ 1 k] at this
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨v, ⟨h, hv⟩, hv2⟩, hkwy⟩ := this
    exists w
    constructor
    · rwa[h]
    · exists k

name: relStar_relProd_eq_relProd_relStar
sig:
theorem relStar_relProd_eq_relProd_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    relProd (relStar ρ) ρ = relProd ρ (relStar ρ)
body: rw [relStar_relProd, relProd_relStar]

name: relPlus_remark3
sig:
theorem relPlus_remark3 {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x y : X} (h : relPlus ρ x y) :
    (∃ u, relStar ρ x u ∧ ρ u y) ∧ (∃ v, ρ x v ∧ relStar ρ v y)
body:
constructor
  · rw[← relStar_relProd ρ] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
    exists u
  · rw[← relProd_relStar ρ] at h
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
    exists v

name: relPlus_remark3'
sig:
theorem relPlus_remark3' {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x y : X} (h : relPlus ρ x y) :
    (∃ u, u ∈ RelDomain ρ ∧ relStar ρ x u ∧ ρ u y) ∧
    (∃ v, v ∈ RelRange ρ ∧ ρ x v ∧ relStar ρ v y)
body:
constructor
  · rw[← relStar_relProd ρ] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
    exists u
    constructor
    · exists y; exact hu.2
    · assumption
  · rw[← relProd_relStar ρ] at h
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
    exists v
    constructor
    · exists x; exact hv.1
    · assumption

name: Exp
sig:
inductive Exp where
  | nat (n : Nat)
  | plus
  | star

name: relExp
sig:
def relExp (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Exp → X → X → Prop
  | .nat n => relPow ρ n
  | .plus => relPlus ρ
  | .star => relStar ρ

name: relPlus_imp_relStar
sig:
theorem relPlus_imp_relStar {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x y : X}
    (h : relPlus ρ x y) : relStar ρ x y
body:
obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  exists (k + 1)

name: remark2_i
sig:
theorem remark2_i (ρ : X → X → Prop) (α : Exp) (x y : X) :
    relExp ρ α x y → relStar ρ x y
body:
cases α with
  | nat n =>
    intro _
    exists n
  | plus =>
    intro h
    exact relPlus_imp_relStar h
  | star => intro _; assumption

name: remark2_ii
sig:
theorem remark2_ii (ρ : X → X → Prop) (α β : Exp) (x y z : X) :
    relExp ρ α x y → relExp ρ β y z → relStar ρ x z
body:
intro hα hβ
  have hα := remark2_i ρ α x y hα
  have hβ  := remark2_i ρ β y z hβ
  exact relStar_trans ρ x y z hα hβ

name: IsPos
sig:
def Exp.IsPos : Exp → Prop
  | .nat n => 0 < n
  | .plus => True
  | .star => False
doc: α is in ℕ⁺ ∪ {+}.

name: relExp_pos
sig:
theorem relExp_pos {ρ : X → X → Prop} {α : Exp} (hα : α.IsPos) {x y : X}
    (h : relExp ρ α x y) : ∃ m, relPow ρ (m + 1) x y
body:
cases α with
  | nat n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => contradiction
    | succ k =>
      exists k
  | plus =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exists k
  | star => contradiction

name: remark2_iii
sig:
theorem remark2_iii (ρ : X → X → Prop) (α β : Exp)
    (hab : α.IsPos ∨ β.IsPos) (x y z : X) :
    relExp ρ α x y → relExp ρ β y z → relPlus ρ x z
body:
intro hα hβ
  rcases hab with hpα | hpβ
  · have ⟨m, hm⟩:= relExp_pos hpα hα
    have ⟨k, hk⟩:= remark2_i ρ β y z hβ
    exists (m + k)
    have hidx : m + k + 1 = (m + 1) + k := by omega
    rw [hidx, relPow_add]
    exists y
  · have ⟨m, hm⟩:= relExp_pos hpβ hβ
    have ⟨k, hk⟩:= remark2_i ρ α x y hα
    exists (k + m)
    rw[Nat.add_assoc, relPow_add]
    exists y

name: relPow_mem_field
sig:
theorem relPow_mem_field {ρ : X → X → Prop} {n : Nat} {x y : X}
    (h : relPow ρ n x y) : x ∈ Field ρ ∧ y ∈ Field ρ
body:
revert x y
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := h
    constructor
    · assumption
    · rw[← h]
      assumption
  | succ k hk =>
    intro x y ⟨z, hkxz, _⟩
    constructor
    · have ⟨_, _⟩:= hk hkxz
      assumption
    · right; exists z

name: relPow_succ_mem
sig:
theorem relPow_succ_mem {ρ : X → X → Prop} {n : Nat} {x y : X}
    (h : relPow ρ (n + 1) x y) : x ∈ RelDomain ρ ∧ y ∈ RelRange ρ
body:
constructor
  · rw[Nat.add_comm, relPow_add] at h
    obtain ⟨z, hxz, _⟩ := h
    rw[relPow_one] at hxz
    exists z
  · obtain ⟨z, _, _⟩ := h
    exists z

name: domain_relPlus
sig: theorem domain_relPlus (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelDomain (relPlus ρ) = RelDomain ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, k, hk⟩
    exact (relPow_succ_mem hk).1
  · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
    exists y, 0
    rwa[relPow_one]

name: range_relPlus
sig: theorem range_relPlus (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelRange (relPlus ρ) = RelRange ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨x, k, hk⟩
    exact (relPow_succ_mem hk).2
  · intro ⟨x, hxy⟩
    exists x, 0
    rwa[relPow_one]

name: domain_relStar
sig: theorem domain_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelDomain (relStar ρ) = Field ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, k, hk⟩
    exact (relPow_mem_field hk).1
  · intro h
    exists x, 0

name: range_relStar
sig: theorem range_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelRange (relStar ρ) = Field ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨x, k, hk⟩
    exact (relPow_mem_field hk).2
  · intro h
    exists y, 0

name: mem_field_iff
sig:
theorem mem_field_iff (ρ : X → X → Prop) (x : X) :
    x ∈ Field ρ ↔ x ∈ RelDomain ρ ∨ x ∈ RelRange ρ
body: Iff.rfl

name: field_relPlus
sig: theorem field_relPlus (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Field (relPlus ρ) = Field ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro x
  rw[mem_field_iff (relPlus ρ), mem_field_iff ρ, domain_relPlus, range_relPlus]

name: field_relStar
sig: theorem field_relStar (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Field (relStar ρ) = Field ρ
body:
apply ext
  intro x
  rw[mem_field_iff (relStar ρ), domain_relStar, range_relStar, or_self]

name: InfDesc
sig: def InfDesc (ρ : X → X → Prop) (a : Nat → X) : Prop
doc: Notes: `a` is an infinite descending ρ-sequence.

name: WF
sig: def WF (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ B : Set X, (∃ x, x ∈ B) → ∃ x, x ∈ B ∧ predR ρ x ∩ B = ∅
doc: Notes: ρ is well founded.

name: IndPrinciple
sig: def IndPrinciple (ρ : X → X → Prop) (A : Set X) : Prop
body:
∀ B : Set X, B ⊆ A →
    (∀ x, x ∈ A → (predR ρ x ∩ A ⊆ B → x ∈ B)) → B = A
doc: Notes: the principle of ρ,A-induction.

name: exists_mem_sdiff
sig:
theorem exists_mem_sdiff {A B : Set X} (hsub : B ⊆ A) (hne : B ≠ A) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ A \ B
body:
by_cases hex : ∃ x, x ∈ A \ B
  · exact hex
  · exfalso
    apply hne
    apply subset_antisymm
    · intro x
      exact hsub x
    · intro x
      intro hx
      by_cases h' : x ∈ B
      · exact h'
      · have : ∃ x, x ∈ A \ B := ⟨x, ⟨hx, h'⟩⟩
        contradiction
doc: Step 1 toward (i) → (ii).

name: inter_subset_of_disjoint_sdiff
sig: theorem inter_subset_of_disjoint_sdiff {A B C : Set X} (h : C ∩ (A \ B) = ∅) : (C ∩ A) ⊆ B
body:
intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
  by_cases h' : x ∈ B
  · exact h'
  · have h'' : x ∈ A \ B := ⟨hx2, h'⟩
    have h''' : x ∈ C ∩ (A \ B) := ⟨hx1, h''⟩
    rw[h] at h'''
    contradiction

name: wf_imp_ind
sig:
theorem wf_imp_ind {ρ : X → X → Prop} (hwf : WF ρ) (A : Set X) :
    IndPrinciple ρ A
body:
intro B hsub hpred
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hBnA
  have hext : ∃ x, x ∈ (A \ B) := exists_mem_sdiff hsub hBnA
  have h := hwf (A \ B) hext
  obtain ⟨x, hx, h⟩ := h
  have hsub : predR ρ x ∩ A ⊆ B := by
    apply inter_subset_of_disjoint_sdiff
    assumption
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
  specialize hpred x hx1 hsub
  contradiction

name: range_nonempty
sig: theorem range_nonempty (a : Nat → X) : ∃ x, x ∈ range a
body: exact ⟨a 0, 0, rfl⟩

name: pred_inter_range_nonempty
body:
intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  have hpred : ρ (a (n+1)) (a n) := hd n
  have hmem : a (n+1) ∈ range a := ⟨n+1, rfl⟩
  rw[hn] at hpred
  exact ⟨a (n+1), ⟨hpred, hmem⟩⟩

name: pred_inter_range_ne_empty
body:
intro x hx hxx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := pred_inter_range_nonempty hd x hx
  rw [hxx] at hy
  exact nothing_empty hy

name: ind_imp_no_desc
sig:
theorem ind_imp_no_desc {ρ : X → X → Prop}
    (h : ∀ A : Set X, IndPrinciple ρ A) : ¬ ∃ a, InfDesc ρ a
body:
intro hex
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
  have hstep : ∀ x, x ∈ range a → predR ρ x ∩ range a ⊆ ∅ → False := by
    intro x hx hsub
    exfalso
    exact pred_inter_range_ne_empty ha x hx (subset_antisymm hsub empty_subset)
  have heq : ∅ = range a := h (range a) ∅ empty_subset hstep
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := range_nonempty a
  rw [← heq] at hx
  exact nothing_empty hx
doc: (ii) → (iii)

name: ind_imp_no_desc'
sig:
theorem ind_imp_no_desc' {ρ : X → X → Prop}
    (h : ∀ A : Set X, IndPrinciple ρ A) : ¬ ∃ a, InfDesc ρ a
body:
intro hex
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
  let A := range a
  specialize h A
  simp[InfDesc] at ha
  have hstep : ∀ x, x ∈ A → (predR ρ x ∩ A ⊆ ∅ → False) := by
    intro x hx hsub
    exfalso
    apply pred_inter_range_ne_empty ha x hx
    apply subset_antisymm
    · assumption
    · exact empty_subset
  have hh := (h ∅ (empty_subset) hstep)
  have h' := range_nonempty a
  have : range a = A := rfl
  rw[this, ← hh] at h'
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h'
  apply nothing_empty
  assumption

name: not_wf_imp_closed_set
sig:
theorem not_wf_imp_closed_set {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : ¬ WF ρ) :
    ∃ B : Set X, (∃ x, x ∈ B) ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ B → ∃ y, y ∈ B ∧ ρ y x
body:
simp[WF] at h
  obtain ⟨B, h⟩ := h
  exists B
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  constructor
  · exact h1
  · intro x hx
    specialize h2 x hx
    have hh : (predR ρ x ∩ B ≠ ∅) → (∃y, y ∈  predR ρ x ∩ B) := by
      intro hh1
      by_cases H : ∃ y, y ∈ predR ρ x ∩ B
      · assumption
      · simp at H
        have : (predR ρ x ∩ B) = ∅ := by apply ext; simp; assumption
        rw[this]
        contradiction
    specialize hh h2
    obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hh
    exists y
doc: ¬ WF gives a nonempty B in which every element has a ρ-predecessor in B.

name: not_wf_of_closed_set
sig:
theorem not_wf_of_closed_set {ρ : X → X → Prop} {B : Set X}
    (hne : ∃ x, x ∈ B) (hB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → ∃ y, y ∈ B ∧ ρ y x) : ¬ WF ρ
body:
intro h
  have ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := h B hne
  have ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩:= hB x hx1
  have : y ∈ predR ρ x ∩ B := ⟨hyx, hy⟩
  rw[hx2] at this
  contradiction

name: exists_step
body:
let ρ' : {x // x ∈ B} → {x // x ∈ B} → Prop := fun x y => ρ y.1 x.1
  have : (∃ f : {x // x ∈ B} → {x // x ∈ B}, ∀ (x : { x // x ∈ B }), ρ (f x).1 x.1) = (∃ f : {x // x ∈ B} → {x // x ∈ B}, ∀ (x : { x // x ∈ B }), ρ' x (f x)) := by rfl
  rw[this]
  apply Classical.axiomOfChoice
  intro x
  let h := hB x.1 x.2
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := h
  exists ⟨y, hy1⟩
doc: A step function on B choosing a predecessor.

name: iter
sig:
def iter {α : Type} (f : α → α) (x₀ : α) : Nat → α
  | 0 => x₀
  | n+1 => f (iter f x₀ n)

name: not_wf_imp_desc
sig:
theorem not_wf_imp_desc {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : ¬ WF ρ) :
    ∃ a, InfDesc ρ a
body:
let hh := (not_wf_imp_closed_set h)
  obtain ⟨B, Bx, hh⟩ := hh
  let h1 := exists_step hh
  obtain ⟨f, fh⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := Bx
  let a' : Nat → { x // x ∈ B } := iter f ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
  let a := fun n => (a' n).1
  exists a
  intro n
  exact fh (a' n)
doc: (iii) → (i), contrapositive form

name: not_desc_imp_wf
sig: theorem not_desc_imp_wf {ρ : X → X → Prop} : (¬ ∃ a, InfDesc ρ a) → WF ρ
body:
intro h
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hh
  have h' := not_wf_imp_desc hh
  contradiction
doc: (iii) → (i)

name: wf_equiv
sig:
theorem wf_equiv (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    (WF ρ ↔ ∀ A, IndPrinciple ρ A) ∧ (WF ρ ↔ ¬ ∃ a, InfDesc ρ a)
body:
constructor
  · constructor
    · exact wf_imp_ind
    · exact fun h => not_desc_imp_wf (ind_imp_no_desc h)
  · constructor
    · exact fun h => ind_imp_no_desc (wf_imp_ind h)
    · exact not_desc_imp_wf
doc: Theorem: the following are equivalent for a relation ρ.

name: WFOn
sig: def WFOn (ρ : X → X → Prop) (A : Set X) : Prop
body: ∀ B : Set X, B ⊆ A → (∃ x, x ∈ B) → ∃ x, x ∈ B ∧ predR ρ x ∩ B = ∅
doc: Notes: ρ is w.f. on A.

name: predR_eq_empty_of_not_mem_range
sig:
theorem predR_eq_empty_of_not_mem_range {ρ : X → X → Prop} {x : X}
    (h : ¬ x ∈ RelRange ρ) : predR ρ x = ∅
body:
apply ext
  intro a
  constructor
  · intro h'
    exfalso
    apply h
    exists a
  · intro _
    contradiction

name: wf_iff_wfOn_range
sig: theorem wf_iff_wfOn_range (ρ : X → X → Prop) : WF ρ ↔ WFOn ρ (RelRange ρ)
body:
constructor
  · intro h
    intro B _
    exact h B
  · intro h B
    by_cases hout : ∃ x, x ∈ B ∧ ¬ x ∈ RelRange ρ
    · intro hh
      obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := hout
      exists x
      constructor
      · assumption
      · have h := predR_eq_empty_of_not_mem_range hx2
        rw[h]
        simp
    · simp at hout
      have h' := h B hout
      assumption

name: ind_range_imp_wfOn
sig:
theorem ind_range_imp_wfOn {ρ : X → X → Prop} :
    IndPrinciple ρ (RelRange ρ) → WFOn ρ (RelRange ρ)
body:
intro h B hB hne
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hno
  have hstep : ∀ x, x ∈ RelRange ρ →
    predR ρ x ∩ RelRange ρ ⊆ RelRange ρ \ B → x ∈ RelRange ρ \ B := by
    intro x Rx hx
    by_cases h' : x ∈ B
    · have hne' : predR ρ x ∩ B ≠ ∅ := fun hempty => hno ⟨x, h', hempty⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := exists_mem_of_ne_empty hne'
      have hyR := hB y hy2
      have hhh := hx y ⟨hy1, hyR⟩
      exfalso
      exact hhh.2 hy2
    · exact ⟨Rx, h'⟩
  have heq : RelRange ρ \ B = RelRange ρ := h (RelRange ρ \ B) sdiff_subset hstep
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  have hn := hB x hx
  exact (heq ▸ hn).2 hx

name: ind_iff_ind_range
sig:
theorem ind_iff_ind_range (ρ : X → X → Prop) :
    (∀ A, IndPrinciple ρ A) ↔ IndPrinciple ρ (RelRange ρ)
body:
constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (RelRange ρ)
  · intro h
    apply (wf_equiv ρ).1.1
    apply (wf_iff_wfOn_range ρ).2
    apply ind_range_imp_wfOn
    assumption

name: wf_of_sub
sig:
theorem wf_of_sub {σ ρ : X → X → Prop} (hsub : RelSub σ ρ) (hwf : WF ρ) :
    WF σ
body:
intro B h
  have Bwf := hwf B h
  obtain⟨k, Bwf1, Bwf2⟩ := Bwf
  exists k
  constructor
  · assumption
  · have : ∀a, a ∈ predR σ k → a ∈ predR ρ k := by
      intro a ha
      simp
      apply hsub
      assumption
    apply ext; intro a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      rw[← Bwf2]
      constructor
      · apply this
        exact ha.1
      · exact ha.2
    · intro _
      contradiction

name: z_not_mem_range
sig: theorem z_not_mem_range : ¬ M.z ∈ RelRange (Rel M)
body:
intro h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  have := M.h2 k
  simp[Rel] at hk
  contradiction

name: eq_of_mem_predR_succ
sig:
theorem eq_of_mem_predR_succ (n : N) :
    ∀ k, k ∈ predR (Rel M) (M.S n) → k = n
body:
intro k hk
  simp[Rel] at hk
  apply M.h1
  assumption

name: succ_ind_range
sig:
theorem succ_ind_range (hind : prop11 M) :
    IndPrinciple (Rel M) (RelRange (Rel M))
body:
intro B BR Bh
  apply ext
  intro a
  constructor
  · exact BR a
  · intro ha
    have key : ∀ m, (m ∈ RelRange (Rel M) → m ∈ B) → M.S m ∈ B := by
      intro m hm
      apply Bh
      exists m
      intro k hk
      obtain⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hk
      have := eq_of_mem_predR_succ M m k hk1
      rw[this]
      apply hm
      rw[← this]
      assumption
    let C : Set N := fun n ↦ M.S n ∈ B
    have h := hind C
    have hh : (M.z ∈ C ∧ ∀ (n : N), n ∈ C → M.S n ∈ C) := by
      constructor
      · apply key
        intro h
        have := z_not_mem_range M h
        contradiction
      · intro n hn
        apply key
        intro hn'
        assumption
    have hC := h hh
    obtain⟨k, hk⟩ := ha
    simp[Rel] at hk
    rw[← hk]
    have : k ∈ C := by rw[hC]; trivial
    assumption
doc: Notes: the principle of S,R_S-induction holds.

name: succ_wf
sig: theorem succ_wf (hind : prop11 M) : WF (Rel M)
body:
have := ind_range_imp_wfOn (succ_ind_range M hind)
  exact (wf_iff_wfOn_range (Rel M)).2 this
doc: Notes: S is well founded.

name: wf_of_wf_relPlus
sig: theorem wf_of_wf_relPlus {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : WF (relPlus ρ)) : WF ρ
body:
intro B hB
  have ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := h B hB
  exists x
  constructor
  · assumption
  · have : (predR ρ x) ⊆ (predR (relPlus ρ) x) := by
      intro y hy
      exists 0, y
      constructor
      · constructor
        · rfl
        · left; exists x
      · exact hy
    apply ext; intro a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      rw[← hx]
      constructor
      · apply this; exact ha.1
      · exact ha.2
    · intro _; contradiction

name: not_wf_of_not_wf_relPlus
sig:
theorem not_wf_of_not_wf_relPlus {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : ¬ WF (relPlus ρ)) :
    ¬ WF ρ
body:
obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_wf_imp_desc h
  let A : Set X := fun x =>
    x ∈ RelDomain (relPlus ρ) ∧ ∃ n, relStar ρ (a (n+1)) x ∧ relStar ρ x (a n)
  have hne : ∃ x, x ∈ A := by
    exists (a 1)
    constructor
    · exists (a 0)
      exact ha 0
    · exists 1
      constructor
      · apply relPlus_imp_relStar
        exact ha 1
      · exists 0
        constructor
        · rfl
        · have ⟨k, l, _,_⟩:= ha 1
          right
          exists l
  have hstep : ∀ x, x ∈ A → ∃ y, y ∈ A ∧ ρ y x := by
    intro x ⟨hx, n, h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h1
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have ⟨h, _⟩ := hk
      subst h
      obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := (relPlus_remark3 (ha (n+1))).1
      exists u
      constructor
      · constructor
        · exists (a (n+1))
          exact relSub_relPlus ρ u (a (n+1)) hu2
        · exists (n+1)
          exact ⟨hu1, relSub_relStar ρ u (a (n+1)) hu2⟩
      · exact hu2
    | succ m =>
      have ⟨y, hk1, hk2⟩ := hk
      exists y
      constructor
      · constructor
        · exists x, 0, y
          constructor
          · constructor
            · rfl
            · left
              exists x
          · assumption
        · exists n
          constructor
          · exists m
          · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h2
            exists (l + 1)
            rw[Nat.add_comm, relPow_add ρ 1 l]
            exists x
            constructor
            · rw[relPow_one]; assumption
            · assumption
      · assumption
  exact not_wf_of_closed_set hne hstep

name: claim_star_I
sig:
theorem claim_star_I {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : ¬ WF (relPlus ρ)) :
    ¬ WF ρ
body:
obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_wf_imp_desc h
  let B : Set X := fun x => ∃ k, relStar ρ (a k) x
  have hne : ∃ x, x ∈ B := by
    exists (a 0), 0, 0
    constructor
    · rfl
    · right
      have ⟨k, y, hk1, hk2⟩ := ha 0
      exists y
  have hstep : ∀ x, x ∈ B → ∃ y, y ∈ B ∧ ρ y x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, n, hn1⟩:= hx
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      obtain⟨h, haa⟩ := hn1
      have ⟨l, y, hk⟩ := ha k
      rw[← h]
      exists y
      constructor
      · exists (k + 1)
        exists l
        exact hk.1
      · exact hk.2
    | succ n =>
      obtain⟨w, hw⟩ := hn1
      exists w
      constructor
      · exists k, n
        exact hw.1
      · exact hw.2
  exact not_wf_of_closed_set hne hstep

name: claim_star_II
sig: theorem claim_star_II {ρ : X → X → Prop} (h : ¬ WF (relPlus ρ)) : ¬ WF ρ
body:
obtain ⟨C, hCne, hC⟩ := not_wf_imp_closed_set h
  let E : Set X := fun x => ∃ c, c ∈ C ∧ relStar ρ c x
  have hEne : ∃ x, x ∈ E := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hCne
    have ⟨c', hc'1, hc'2⟩ := hC c hc
    exists c, c'
    constructor
    · assumption
    · apply relPlus_imp_relStar
      assumption
  have hE : ∀ y, y ∈ E → ∃ u, u ∈ E ∧ ρ u y := by
    intro y ⟨c, hc1, hcy⟩
    obtain ⟨c', hc'1, hc'2⟩ := hC c hc1
    have h3 : relPlus ρ c' y :=
      remark2_iii ρ .plus .star (Or.inl trivial) c' c y hc'2 hcy
    obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := (relPlus_remark3 h3).1
    exact ⟨u, ⟨c', hc'1, hu1⟩, hu2⟩
  exact not_wf_of_closed_set hEne hE

name: wf_relPlus_iff
sig: theorem wf_relPlus_iff (ρ : X → X → Prop) : WF ρ ↔ WF (relPlus ρ)
body:
constructor
  · exact fun p => Classical.byContradiction fun q => not_wf_of_not_wf_relPlus q p
  · exact wf_of_wf_relPlus

name: natPeano
sig:
def natPeano : PeanoLike Nat where
  z
body:
0
  S := Nat.succ
  h1 := by intro x y hxy; apply Nat.succ_inj.1; assumption
  h2 := Nat.succ_ne_zero
  h3 := by intro n; cases n with | zero => left; rfl | succ n => right; exists n

name: natPeano_ind
sig: theorem natPeano_ind : prop11 natPeano
body:
intro B hB
  apply ext
  intro n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    trivial
  · intro hn
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hB.1
    | succ n hnn => exact hB.2 n (hnn hn)

name: relPow_nat
sig:
theorem relPow_nat (n x y : Nat) :
    relPow (Rel natPeano) n x y ↔ x + n = y
body:
constructor
  · revert x y
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x y hxy
      obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hxy
      omega
    | succ n hn =>
      intro x y hxy
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := hxy
      have := hn x k hk1
      have hk2' : Nat.succ k = y := hk2
      omega
  · revert x y
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x y hxy
      constructor
      · omega
      · left; exists (Nat.succ x)
    | succ k hk =>
      intro x y hxy
      rw[← hxy]
      exists (x + k)
      constructor
      · apply hk
        rfl
      · trivial
doc: ρ^n for the successor relation is "add n".

name: relStar_nat
sig: theorem relStar_nat (x y : Nat) : relStar (Rel natPeano) x y ↔ x ≤ y
body:
constructor
  · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have := (relPow_nat k x y).1 hk
    omega
  · intro h
    have ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.le.dest h
    exists k
    exact (relPow_nat k x y).2 hk

name: relPlus_nat
sig: theorem relPlus_nat (x y : Nat) : relPlus (Rel natPeano) x y ↔ x < y
body:
constructor
  · intro ⟨k, l, hkl, hly⟩
    have := (relPow_nat k x l).1 hkl
    have : (x + k).succ = l.succ := by omega
    have hyl : y = l.succ := by exact hly.symm
    omega
  · intro hxy
    have : ∃k : Nat, x.succ + k = y := by exact Nat.le.dest hxy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := this
    have : x + k.succ = y := by omega
    have := (relPow_nat k.succ x y).2 this
    exists k

name: lt_wf
sig: theorem lt_wf : WF (fun x y : Nat => x < y)
body:
have : relPlus (Rel natPeano) = (fun x y : Nat => x < y) := by
    ext x y
    exact relPlus_nat x y
  rw[← this]
  apply (wf_relPlus_iff (Rel natPeano)).mp ?_
  exact  succ_wf natPeano natPeano_ind
doc: The sheet's corollary: `<` is well founded.

name: course_of_values
sig:
theorem course_of_values (B : Set Nat)
    (h : ∀ n, (∀ k, k < n → k ∈ B) → n ∈ B) : B = univ
body:
have := (wf_equiv (fun x y : Nat => x < y)).1.1 lt_wf univ
  apply this
  intro n Bn
  trivial
  intro n _ hn
  have := h n
  apply this; intro k hk
  exact hn k ⟨hk, trivial⟩
doc: Course of values induction.

name: IrreflRel
sig: def IrreflRel (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x, ¬ ρ x x

name: StrictPO
sig: def StrictPO (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: IrreflRel ρ ∧ TransRel ρ

name: Smallest
sig: def Smallest (ρ : X → X → Prop) (B : Set X) (x : X) : Prop
body: x ∈ B ∧ ∀ y, y ∈ B → x = y ∨ ρ x y
doc: x is a smallest element of B for ρ.

name: WellOrder
sig: def WellOrder (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ B : Set X, B ⊆ Field ρ → (∃ x, x ∈ B) → ∃ x, Smallest ρ B x

name: range_sub_field
sig: theorem range_sub_field (ρ : X → X → Prop) : RelRange ρ ⊆ Field ρ
body:
intro x ⟨y, hx⟩
  right
  exists y

name: wo_imp_wfOn_field
sig:
theorem wo_imp_wfOn_field {ρ : X → X → Prop} (hs : StrictPO ρ) (hw : WellOrder ρ) :
    WFOn ρ (Field ρ)
body:
intro B h hB
  have ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := hw B h hB
  exists x
  constructor
  · assumption
  · apply ext
    intro y
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
      have := hx2 y hy2
      cases this
      · rename_i hh
        have hy1' : ρ y x := hy1
        rw[hh] at hy1'
        have := hs.1 y hy1'
        contradiction
      . rename_i hh
        have hy1' : ρ y x := hy1
        have hxx : ρ x x := hs.2 x y x hh hy1'
        have := hs.1 x hxx
        contradiction
    · intro _
      contradiction

name: wo_imp_wf
sig:
theorem wo_imp_wf {ρ : X → X → Prop} (hs : StrictPO ρ) (hw : WellOrder ρ) :
    WF ρ
body:
apply (wf_iff_wfOn_range ρ).2
  intro B h Bh
  have : B ⊆ Field ρ := fun b hh => (range_sub_field ρ b) (h b hh)
  exact wo_imp_wfOn_field hs hw B this Bh

name: LinearRel
sig: def LinearRel (ρ : X → X → Prop) : Prop
body: ∀ x y, x = y ∨ ρ x y ∨ ρ y x
doc: Notes: ρ is linear (any two elements are comparable).

name: wf_imp_wo
sig:
theorem wf_imp_wo {ρ : X → X → Prop} (hl : LinearRel ρ) (hw : WF ρ) :
    WellOrder ρ
body:
intro B Bh Bh'
  have ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := hw B Bh'
  exists x
  constructor
  · assumption
  · intro y hy
    cases hl x y
    · left; assumption
    · rename_i h
      cases h
      · right; assumption
      · rename_i h; have : y ∈ predR ρ x ∩ B := ⟨h, hy⟩
        rw[hx2] at this
        contradiction

name: not_wf_imp_wo
sig:
theorem not_wf_imp_wo :
    ¬ ∀ ρ : Nat → Nat → Prop, StrictPO ρ → WF ρ → WellOrder ρ
body:
intro h
  let ρ : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun x y => x = 0 ∧ (y = 1 ∨ y = 2)
  have h1 : StrictPO ρ := by
    constructor
    · intro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      cases hx2
      · omega
      · omega
    · intro x y z ⟨hxy1, _⟩  ⟨_, hyz2⟩
      constructor
      · assumption
      · assumption
  have h2 : WF ρ := by
    intro B ⟨x, hx⟩
    by_cases h : 0 ∈ B
    · exists 0
      constructor
      · assumption
      · apply ext; intro y
        constructor
        · intro ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, hy3⟩
          cases hy2; omega; omega
        · intro _; contradiction
    · exists x
      constructor
      · assumption
      · apply ext; intro y
        constructor
        · intro ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, hy3⟩
          rw[hy1] at hy3
          contradiction
        · intro _; contradiction
  have h3 : ¬(WellOrder ρ) := by
    intro h
    let B : Set Nat := fun x => x = 1 ∨ x = 2
    have Bh : B ⊆ Field ρ := by
      intro x hx
      right
      exists 0
    have Bh' : ∃x, x ∈ B := ⟨1, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hx2⟩⟩ := h B Bh Bh'
    cases hx1
    · have := hx2 2 (Or.inr rfl)
      cases this
      · omega
      · omega
    · have := hx2 1 (Or.inl rfl)
      cases this
      · omega
      · omega
  exact h3 (h ρ h1 h2)

name: wo_iff_wf
sig:
theorem wo_iff_wf {ρ : X → X → Prop} (hs : StrictPO ρ) (hl : LinearRel ρ) :
    WellOrder ρ ↔ WF ρ
body: ⟨wo_imp_wf hs, wf_imp_wo hl⟩
